purpose: Decide whether existing tiny/local models are adequate, or whether the bounded Qwen 3B GPU smoke remains necessary for the paper claim.

systems.implication: Good coverage baseline, but support is below the desired grounded-correctness target.
Raises judged correctness by abstaining more; not enough to answer whether a trained student can preserve support at useful coverage.
Decent answer rate but very weak judged support, so extractive local scaffolds are not the final answer.
Learns citation formatting but fails support preservation; this is a negative result for tiny-model generic SFT.
The tiny local SFT path can collapse to all abstentions, which is not acceptable final behavior.
Local contract gating controls output shape but does not prove support without a grounded judge.
The 3B base model can run locally and answer many prompts, but weak inline citation and JSON contract behavior show that the joint-action LoRA objective is still needed.
A deterministic citation-string repair lifts inline citation rate to 100%, but leaves answer type, cited evidence ids, and support risk unchanged.

qwen3b_acceptance_target.minimum: Beat the direct baseline on answer support and overall judged correctness while keeping answer rate above 70%; if that is not possible, report the exact coverage/support frontier instead of claiming support-preserving distillation.

rationale: The tiny Qwen 0.5B SFT result has high inline citation compliance but only 5.0% judged answer support and 42.0% overall judged correctness on the final window.
The compact local Qwen 0.5B SFT path collapses to all abstentions, so it cannot answer the support-preserving distillation question.

The local Qwen 3B base-control answers 83.3% of a 12-example future-window slice, but reaches only 15.0% inline citation rate and 83.3% valid JSON, so scale alone does not satisfy the grounded citation contract.

A zero-call citation repair lifts that local Qwen 3B slice to 100.0% inline citation rate without changing answer type, citation precision, citation recall, or support risk, so formatting repair is not enough for the paper claim.
The best zero-call scaffold improves support/correctness by reducing answer coverage, so the missing evidence is a trained student that can recover useful coverage.

The Qwen 3B joint-action packet already encodes answer repair, abstention, citation placement, and support-risk contrast; the next credible paid step is the bounded Qwen 3B smoke, not a larger open-ended GPU experiment.
Prime auth currently blocks execution before wallet or live price checks, so no pod should be created until the auth/price gate passes under the $100 total cap.

next_experiment.success_condition: Beat direct baseline support/correctness while keeping answer rate at or above 70%; otherwise report a negative result against the coverage-constrained frontier.

llm_budget.note: This audit reads existing artifacts only.
